comparison.objective: Tighten a nut onto a bolt.
comparison.physical_skill: Basic nut-and-bolt thread engagement and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Only a tightened nut is specified; setup, seating depth, torque, retention, and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: The candidate meaningfully adds a separately adjustable screw whose setting must be counterheld during jam-nut locking and proven by released repeated actuation.
